Maya (Marketing): Quick thread to lock the May newsletter + benchmark webinar plan. Need final segments, A/B subjects, send cadence, and HubSpot routing. Who owns the send & QA?

Evan (Growth): I can own send + reporting. Suggested segments:
- devs: active_api_users_14d
- trials_warm: trial_started_14d AND product_open_rate >= 30%
- enterprise: enterprise_accounts

Priya (Demand Gen): Subject options:
A) "Benchmark: faster inference + cost playbook"
B) "See our benchmark + live demo (Wed)"
Preview: "30m webinar + Q&A"

Jules (Content): Dev email = code snippet + perf chart. Trials = 1-click demo CTA. Enterprise = whitepaper + customer quote.

Tom (Sales Ops): HubSpot routing rules to add:
- webinar signups -> tag=benchmark_may_2026 + enroll in workflow webinar_followup_may
- company_size >= 100 AND intent_score >= 65 -> create AE task
- trials_warm with recent_activity -> assign to SDR queue

Asha (Head of Marketing): Legal needs exact % language before send. Also keep a 2% holdout for lift.

Evan (Growth): I'll QA UTMs/tracking with Priya. UTMs: utm_source=newsletter&utm_campaign=benchmark_may_2026&utm_content={segment}. ETA Mon 2pm PT.

HubSpot Bot: Created workflow "webinar_followup_may" (ID: 44121).

Maya (Marketing): Action items recap: Evan=QA+send; Priya=nurture flow; Tom=workflows; Jules=copy; Asha=legal. Drop final subject by Mon EOD. Thanks!
